# 1 Enoch Chapter 57 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 57:1 — 'host of clouds of light' — the composition of the angelic armies

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "host of-clouds of-light" | Literal construct chain; preserve Ge'ez structure |
| LOGOS | "host of clouds of light" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "armies made of luminous clouds" | Interpretive expansion; 'luminous' explicates 'light' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/EMET. 'Host of clouds of light' preserves the layered construct and the imagery of luminous angelic armies. PNEUMA's 'luminous clouds' is a reasonable interpretation but loses the Ge'ez construct chain.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 57:3 — 'their lot' vs. 'their portion' for the peace promised to the elect

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "peace shall-be their-lot" | 'Lot' = allotted portion (Ge'ez beqel) |
| LOGOS | "peace shall be their portion" | 'Portion' more natural English for the same concept |
| PNEUMA | "their portion will be peace" | Agrees with LOGOS; inverts word order for natural flow |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's 'portion' as the more natural English equivalent of the Ge'ez beqel in context. 'Lot' (EMET) is defensible but slightly archaic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 57:3 — 'planted in it' — the eschatological rootedness of the righteous

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-be-planted in-it" | Literal; Ge'ez agricultural metaphor |
| LOGOS | "they shall be planted in it" | Preserves the metaphor directly |
| PNEUMA | "they will be planted deep in it" | Adds 'deep' for rhetorical emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The agricultural metaphor 'planted' should be preserved without expansion. PNEUMA's 'deep' is not in the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
